call_points.text: Management kept the ₹5,000 Cr revenue and ₹1,000 Cr+ EBITDA vision over three to four years, about 2x.
Chairman guides 20% CAGR with similar EBITDA margins, calling last year's number times 20% twice the minimum.
Phase-2 adds 12,000 MT to 66,000 MT and is targeted for completion by September 2027.
New Maltol, Ethyl Maltol and specialty plants are expected to be mechanically complete by mid-next year, with contributions from H2 of next financial year.
Capacity utilisation is around 90% of installed capacity.
The merger scheme has been filed with NCLT after exchange observation letters; completion is expected this financial year.
Alpha-pinene prices are at historic highs; management says CST is contracted back-to-back and GTO-based costs are passed on.
Management declined to give a volume-versus-realisation split, saying it discloses volume growth only annually.
Long-term vision of ₹5,000 Cr revenue and ₹1,000 Cr+ EBITDA over next 3-4 years, about 2x current scale.
First capex phase to complete by 30 June 2026, raising installed capacity to 54,000 tpa.
All three capex phases to take capacity to 72,000 tpa by around June-September 2028.
New products ethyl maltol, maltol and cyclopentanone targeted for mechanical completion by June 2027.
Gross margin dip in Q4 due to overlap of raw material and finished goods annual contracts; management advises judging on annualised basis.
Raw material covered for about a quarter for contracted materials and 3 months stock plus 2-3 months pipeline for others.
Merger of Privi Fine Sciences and Privi Biotechnologies received exchange no-objection; NCLT approval targeted for Q3FY27.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth of 20% in FY27 on standalone basis
EBITDA margins to be sustained at 25%
Vision of ₹5,000 Cr revenue and ₹1,000 Cr+ EBITDA over next 3-4 years
PRIGIV JV revenue of ₹130 Cr in current year, targeting ₹300 Cr in 3-4 years
Vision of ₹5,000 Cr revenue and ₹1,000 Cr+ EBITDA over the next three to four years, about 2x growth
Confident of 20% CAGR with similar EBITDA margins
EBITDA margins expected to sustain at 20%+ and near 24.58% in the near future
Raw material cost guided at 52-55% of sales
Capex of ₹850-900 Cr over this year and the following two years for Phase-2 and Phase-3

industry: Commodities > Chemicals > Chemicals & Petrochemicals > Specialty Chemicals

operating_notes.text: FY26 sales volume was about 42,389 metric tons, up 6.5% YoY.
Working capital cycle reduced to 117 days in FY26.
PRIGIV JV turned profitable in Q4FY26; additional capex of ₹50 Cr being implemented.
Capacity utilisation was around 90% of installed capacity in Q1FY27.
The PRIGIV JV generated about ₹18 Cr of revenue in Q1FY27 with 14-15% EBITDA, and its output is sold exclusively to Givaudan.
Camphor is about 4-6% of total revenue, and crude-based raw material is about 15-18% of overall purchases.

timeline.summary: Privi Speciality Chemicals held its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 12, 2026, guiding 20% revenue growth and 25% EBITDA margins for FY27, with a long-term vision of ₹5,000 Cr revenue and ₹1,000 Cr+ EBITDA in 3-4 years.

On its 31 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, Privi guided to ₹5,000 Cr revenue and ₹1,000 Cr+ EBITDA in three to four years, said Phase-1 capacity would reach 54,000 MT by September 2026 and Phase-2 66,000 MT by September 2027, and put three-year capex at ₹850-900 Cr.

upcoming_events.description: First phase of capex expansion to complete, capacity to 54,000 tpa

watchlist.response: Attributed to overlap of raw material and finished goods annual contracts; advised judging on annualised basis.
watchlist.text: Gross margin dip sequentially in Q4
Timeline for NCLT approval of merger

watchlist.response: Expects at most 3-5% increase, confident of managing.

watchlist.text: NCLT sanction of the merger scheme

watchlist.response: CFO attributed it to last year's low-cost raw material and high selling prices, guided RMC at 52-55% of sales, and said other-expense savings offset it.
watchlist.text: Gross margin fell about 650 bps YoY to 44.2% even as revenue grew 20%; analysts asked how much would recover in FY27.

watchlist.response: CFO clarified the 6,000 MT slips to September 2026 and Phase-2's balance 12,000 MT completes by September 2027.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked whether Phase-2 capacity comes in June 2027 or September 2027, citing a discrepancy with the annual report.

watchlist.response: Management declined, saying it discloses volume growth only annually and calling it an all-round growth.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for the volume growth versus realisation split.

watchlist.response: Management declined, citing a board directive to stop disclosing product mix and segments.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for the product and molecule revenue mix.
